tool_input.command:
cd $REPO_JOB_HUNTER && cat > /tmp/opencode/run_driver.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, time, uuid, httpx

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("JOB_HUNTER_BRIDGE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8686")
URL = os.environ.get("JOB_HUNTER_TARGET_URL", "https://jll.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/jllcareers/job/Creve-Coeur-MO/Specialist--HVAC-Technician_REQ495034")
api_key = $SECRET
for line in open("$REPO_JOB_HUNTER/.env"):
    if line.startswith("CLOUD_API_KEY="):
        api_key = $SECRET"=", 1)[1].strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        break
headers = {"X-API-Key": api_key} if api_key else {}
payload = {
    "request_id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
    "url": URL,
    "executor_backend": "playwright",
    "execution_host": "local",
    "controls": [],
    "profile_data": {},
    "debug_enabled": True,
}
print(f"RUN_ID {payload['request_id']}", flush=True)
open("/tmp/opencode/run_id.txt", "w").write(payload["request_id"])
with httpx.stream("POST", f"{BASE_URL}/api/agent/stream", headers=headers, json=payload,
                  timeout=httpx.Timeout(3600.0, connect=30.0)) as resp:
    print(f"status={resp.status_code}", flush=True)
    for line in resp.iter_lines():
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.startswith("data:"):
            raw = line[5:].strip()
            try:
                ev = json.loads(raw)
                stamp = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                etype = ev.get("type")
                if etype in ("INTERRUPT_REQUEST", "BROWSER_NAVIGATION_MILESTONE", "RUN_PAUSED", "RUN_COMPLETED", "RUN_ERROR"):
                    print(f"[{stamp}] {etype} {json.dumps({k:v for k,v in ev.items() if k not in ('type','sequence')})[:280]}", flush=True)
                elif etype in ("GRAPH_OPERATION_COMPLETED", "PHASE_MESSAGE", "RUN_STARTED"):
                    print(f"[{stamp}] {etype} {json.dumps({k:v for k,v in ev.items() if k not in ('type','sequence')})[:150]}", flush=True)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                pass
PYEOF
python3 -m py_compile /tmp/opencode/run_driver.py && echo "driver ok"
